resources.string:
Camera not found. Please check:
1) Cable connection
2) Camera power
3) PC / PTP mode on the camera
USB I/O error. Please switch the camera from Mass Storage to PTP / MTP mode.
Response timed out. Try a different USB cable.
USB permission was denied. Reconnect the cable and grant permission again.
This USB device is not supported.
Please restart the app and try again.
Automatically reconnect when the camera Wi-Fi is available again
Turn on the phone hotspot, then join it from the camera\'s Wi-Fi settings (SSID/password). Once connected, search for the camera below or connect by IP.
Turn on the phone hotspot so the camera can connect

Image transfer mode: photos taken during live view arrive only after live view is turned off, and browsing the memory card is unavailable. Set the camera\'s computer-connection type to camera control for full features.

This camera is in image transfer mode. Connecting works, but photos taken during live view arrive only after live view ends, and the memory card cannot be browsed.\n\nChange the computer-connection type on the camera to camera control, then search again. Some older models only support image transfer.
Check the camera first: 1) it has joined the phone hotspot, 2) its smart-device (Wi-Fi) connection menu is on, 3) power saving has not switched Wi-Fi off. Then search again.
Wi-Fi is not connected. Turn on Wi-Fi and join a network, or start your hotspot.
Connected to the camera AP, but no camera was found.\nCheck the camera\'s Wi-Fi settings and try again.
Searching is paused while the camera is in use. Disconnect or stop wireless transfer, then try again.
This may be a shared network. Make sure the camera is yours before selecting it.
After connecting, an approval request appears on that camera\'s screen. Make sure it is your camera.
Use a manually entered IP to reconnect to a camera you have already paired.
